description: "History of the United Netherlands from the Death of William the Silent to the Twelve Year's Truce--1609" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The book delves into the complex political and social dynamics of the United Netherlands during a tumultuous period marked by struggles for independence from Spanish rule and various negotiations for peace.
